description_en: Gets the detailed information about a data source, including its type, connection information, and configuration
description_zh: 获取数据源详细信息，包括类型、连接信息和配置
kebab_example: aliyun paifeaturestore get-datasource --instance-id fs-00000000 --datasource-id datasource1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDatasource

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the ListInstances operation
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The data source ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the ListDatasources operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，可通过接口ListDatasources获取
parameters.name: datasource_id

Config.title_en: The type-specific configuration (JSON string). Keys vary by Type: MaxCompute/TableStore — not used; Hologres — may contain `vpc_id`, `vswitch_id`; FeatureDB — may contain `username`, `password`, `vpc_id`, `vswitch_ids`.
Config.title_zh: The type-specific configuration (JSON string). Keys vary by Type: MaxCompute/TableStore — not used; Hologres — may contain `vpc_id`, `vswitch_id`; FeatureDB — may contain `username`, `password`, `vpc_id`, `vswitch_ids`.

DatasourceId.description_en: The ID of the data source

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time the data source was created
GmtCreateTime.title_zh: The time when the datasource was created.

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The time the data source was last updated
GmtModifiedTime.title_zh: The time when the datasource was last updated.

Name.description_en: The name of the data source

The type of the data source. Valid values:

Hologres

Redis

MaxCompute

Hologres

Type.title_en: The type of the datasource: MaxCompute, Hologres, TableStore, or FeatureDB.
Type.title_zh: The type of the datasource: MaxCompute, Hologres, TableStore, or FeatureDB.

Uri.title_en: The resource identifier. Format depends on Type: MaxCompute — project name; Hologres — `<instanceId>/<database>`; TableStore — instance name; FeatureDB — not used.
Uri.title_zh: The resource identifier. Format depends on Type: MaxCompute — project name; Hologres — `<instanceId>/<database>`; TableStore — instance name; FeatureDB — not used.
